context: write a haiku about ireland in the style of basho. include a title wrapped in double angular brackets, i.e. <<title>>. your entire response should be in lowercase english and contain the letter g at least 8 times.

trace.content:
<<green isle>>
green grass grows on green hills
green water flows through green valleys
green ghosts walk the green path
